heroHeadline: Junta Captures Mawlu, Secures Mandalay–Myitkyina Highway — Bhamo Monastery Airstrike Kills 15; Salin Hostages Executed; 11 PDF Fighters Ambushed
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,921 of Myanmar's civil war (May 7, 2026), the junta completed a major strategic gain by capturing Mawlu (May 5), securing the full Mandalay–Myitkyina highway corridor for the first time since the resistance seized it in December 2023 — cutting KIA overland logistics to Sagaing. Simultaneously, a SAC airstrike on a monastery in Bhamo Township killed 15 civilians, junta troops in Salin Township executed two hostages including an elderly disabled woman after burning five villages, and 11 PDF fighters from the Taungtha (Mandalay) Min Thar Gyi column were killed in a junta ambush with bodies reportedly burned. Former foreign ministers and UN experts issued a formal call for international recognition of the NUG acting president. The SAC is also reportedly eyeing a new offensive on Rikhawdar — the strategic India-border hub in Chin State held by the Chin resistance since November 2023 — as it consolidates its western Myanmar push following the Falam recapture (April 25-26).
footerNote: Data sourced from AAPP, ACLED, UN OCHA, Irrawaddy, RFA, Myanmar Now, DVB, Al Jazeera, Mizzima, Human Rights Watch, Crisis Group, Myanmar Peace Monitor, MoeMaKa CDM News, IMNA / Mon News Agency, CPJ, NPR, Northeast Live TV, Kachin Human Rights Watch, Aryan Age, Myanmar Peace Monitor, NUG Ministry of Human Rights, Committee to Protect Journalists, and official NUG, KNU, KIA, AA, and PDF statements.
